summary: First test run for SQZ catalog (squiiz by Lemon Jelly inspired). Backend has only /api/health which works perfectly. Frontend Home, Produtos, navigation, filters, and all 36 product images load correctly. All required data-testids present and functional.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx (240 lines) and Produtos.jsx are well-structured and within size limits.
ProductCard uses loading='lazy' for images which is good for the large brand PNGs (~1-1.5MB).
FallingDrops component correctly sets pointer-events-none and z-0 so it does not block UI clicks.
Filter buttons on Produtos: when 'all' filter is active, the inline color is set to #FBD503 yellow but text color overridden to #151515 — works fine; non-issue.

Backend has CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True — this combo is technically rejected by spec (browsers ignore credentials when origin is *). For a public catalog this is harmless but could be tightened later.
Note: tests/__init__.py is not present — pytest discovers fine without it; no fix needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend = single /api/health endpoint, fully passing. Frontend = catalog only with two routes / and /produtos. Verified: hero (SQZ + SQUIZZ + slogan), lemon squeeze animation, marquee, sobre section, featured grid (8 cards), navigation between Início and Produtos, all 6 filter buttons (all/colares/brincos/aneis/capas/acessorios) with correct counts (36/11/10/5/5/5), all 36 product images load (no broken images), footer with 'squiiz by Lemon Jelly' branding. Some net::ERR_ABORTED appear in network log during fast scroll due to lazy-loading interruptions, but images recover and load correctly — not actionable. Site is in Portuguese as required. Use viewport 1920x1080 and allow ~15s after navigating to /produtos for large PNG assets.
